name: Azeezia Medical College Hospital (Azeezia Institute of Medical Sciences and Research)
tagline: Established private medical college hospital providing tertiary and super‑speciality care
summary: Private teaching hospital at Meeyannoor (Kollam) offering multi‑speciality and super‑speciality tertiary care, emergency services and medical education for North Kerala patients.
description: Azeezia Medical College Hospital is a private teaching hospital and part of the Azeezia group at Diamond Hill, Meeyannoor (Kollam). It combines a multi‑speciality clinical hospital with allied medical, dental and nursing education units.

The campus functions as a tertiary referral centre for North Kerala with a wide range of departments (cardiology, neurosurgery, nephrology, surgical gastroenterology, paediatrics, neonatology, orthopaedics, plastic surgery, radiology and more) and a large inpatient capacity.

It is an accredited teaching hospital that admits MBBS and postgraduate students and is empanelled under several government health schemes; the hospital also holds NABH entry‑level accreditation (certificate validity published by NABH).
Visitors and patients use the hospital both for emergency 24/7 care and planned super‑speciality treatments; confirm specifics (appointments, insurance empanelment and visiting rules) before travel.
highlights: Private tertiary medical college hospital serving Kollam and North Kerala
Wide range of super‑speciality departments (neurosurgery, cardiology, nephrology, surgical gastroenterology, etc.)
Teaching hospital admitting MBBS and postgraduate students
NABH entry‑level accreditation and empanelment under state/national schemes
Campus includes allied institutions (dental, nursing) for integrated care and training

sections.heading: Background
body: Azeezia began as a group of healthcare and educational institutions at Meeyannoor, Kollam. The medical college and attached hospital operate as a private, trust‑run teaching hospital serving patients from Kollam and neighbouring northern districts.
The institution is listed on official district and medical‑education registers as Azeezia Medical College / Azeezia Institute of Medical Sciences and Research (Meeyannoor P.O., Kollam).

sections.heading: Services & specialties
body: The hospital advertises a full range of clinical departments and super‑speciality services — cardiology, critical care, neurosurgery, nephrology, paediatrics and neonatology, surgical gastroenterology, orthopaedics, urology, plastic surgery, radiology and allied services such as pathology and rehabilitation.
Azeezia functions as a tertiary referral centre with 24/7 emergency and trauma services and in‑house diagnostic and intensive care facilities to support complex surgical and medical cases.

sections.heading: Education, accreditation & schemes
body: The hospital is a teaching hospital attached to the medical college (MBBS) and runs postgraduate courses; the National Medical Commission (NMC) register shows the college name recorded as Azeezia Institute of Medical Sciences and Research in 2026 and recent permissions relate to MBBS/PG seat allocations.

Azeezia holds NABH entry‑level accreditation (certificate listings show validity through 2026) and appears on empanelment lists for schemes such as PM‑JAY and ECHS — useful for patients with insurance or government scheme coverage. Always confirm current empanelment directly with the hospital before admission.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Location: Diamond Hill / Kummalloor–Meeyannoor Road, Meeyannoor P.O., Kollam 691537. The campus includes the medical college hospital, dental and nursing colleges and associated facilities.

Practical: the hospital receives emergency cases 24/7; for planned admissions call ahead for appointment, confirm insurance/empanelment and bring prior medical records and referral documents. Confirm visiting hours and inpatient amenities with the hospital directly before travel.

latest.text: NABH entry‑level accreditation listed for Azeezia Medical College Hospital with certificate validity noted through 2026‑09‑09 in NABH records.
Letter of Permission (LoP) dated 2026‑08‑05 recorded an increase in MBBS intake (LoP for adding 50 seats to reach 150 for AY 2026‑27 in NMC/seat‑matrix snapshots).
NMC portal records the college name as changed to 'Azeezia Institute of Medical Sciences and Research' (approval of competent authority dated 2026‑07‑06).

visitorInfo.bestTime: Year‑round — hospital services and emergency care operate continuously
visitorInfo.howToReach: About 15–20 km from Kollam city centre (Meeyannoor area). Reach by taxi from Kollam Railway Station or bus to nearby junctions (Kottiyam/Chathannoor) and a short road transfer to the campus; confirm local transport and time estimates before travel.
etiquette: Confirm current empanelment with your insurer/PM‑JAY/ECHS before admission.
Carry prior medical records, referral letters and government ID; keep digital and printed copies.
Call ahead for appointments, specialist clinics and to check visiting‑hour rules.
For planned admissions confirm bed type, estimated costs and any required pre‑admission tests.
